Hey @JugglerX,

Sorry for the delayed response, just wanted to let you know that with the coming of Next.js app dir, we're currently rethinking the way we do SSR with React InstantSearch, and I'll make sure not not overlook use-cases such as yours with category pages and Next links. It should still take a while though.

I've been trying on `bal-router`'s latest commit and haven't seen any problem on my side, done a lot of back/next and playing with filters, I'm on Chromium 115.
Is it still a problem for you ? If so, please let us know :)
